name: San Juan
living: the moonlight path on the Atlantic glitters and ripples slowly
the full moon glows softly with a faint halo while thin night clouds drift past it
stars twinkle across the navy sky
the warm lamps along the El Morro fortress walls flicker gently like lanterns
pastel colonial house windows and street lamps flicker on and off
palm trees sway slowly in the warm sea breeze
the red-white-blue bunting on the outfield wall ripples softly
light-tower lamp banks breathe softly with moths circling the cones
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
